newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures pare gains late, end mostly up.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures pare gains late, end mostly up.

text.p: CME lumber futures eased from sharp early gains but ended mostly higher with November pacing the advance on an oversold condition, traders said.

Spot September showed strength from the start ahead of its expiration Friday. September continued to firm on short covering prompted by the discount it holds to cash. Private reports put cash spruce in the $430 to $432 per tbf area and this leaves September at a large discount, traders said.
Back months followed, especially November which had become oversold late Wednesday and also holds a very large discount, they said.
Lumber closed $5.50 per tbf higher to $3.80 lower with September up $4.60 at $418.50 and November up most at $371.00 per tbf.
